mapper.sql: select t.trial_id, t.trial_name, t.batch_id, t.crop_type, t.variety_name, t.research_center_id, t.project_id, t.sub_project_id, t.theme_field_id, t.region, t.zone, t.woreda, t.kebele, t.agricultural_eco_zone, t.gps_location, t.start_date, t.activity_code, t.kpi_code, t.season, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.create_by, t.update_by, t.is_deleted, (select count(1) from trial_plot_relation r where r.trial_id = t.trial_id and r.is_deleted = 0) as plot_count from trial_basic t
mapper.select:
t.is_deleted = 0
AND t.batch_id = #{batchId}
AND t.trial_id like concat('%', #{trialId}, '%')
AND t.trial_name like concat('%', #{trialName}, '%')
AND t.crop_type = #{cropType}
AND t.variety_name like concat('%', #{varietyName}, '%')
order by t.create_time desc

select t.trial_id, t.trial_name, t.batch_id, t.crop_type, t.variety_name, t.research_center_id, t.project_id, t.sub_project_id, t.theme_field_id, t.region, t.zone, t.woreda, t.kebele, t.agricultural_eco_zone, t.gps_location, t.start_date, t.activity_code, t.kpi_code, t.season, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.create_by, t.update_by, t.is_deleted, p.ground_id, p.trial_field_name, p.gps_location as plot_gps_location from trial_basic t left join trial_plot_relation r on t.trial_id = r.trial_id and r.is_deleted = 0 left join plot_info p on r.ground_id = p.ground_id and p.is_deleted = 0 where t.trial_id = #{trialId} and t.is_deleted = 0
